name: Auro Impex & Chemicals Ltd
tagline: A niche micro-cap manufacturer/exporter of electrostatic-precipitator electrodes and spares, high promoter holding and no pledge, but shrinking revenue and weak returns on capital - no thesis.
business_overview: Auro Impex & Chemicals Ltd manufactures, exports and supplies Discharge & Collecting Electrodes and Electrostatic Precipitator (ESP) internal parts/spares - pollution-control equipment components used in power plants, cement and steel industries. Promoters are Madhusudan Goenka and Praveen Kumar Goenka. Seeded 2026-09-13 via untrusted X triage (@rajuidesai, medium conviction).
fundamentals_table: ~71.6% promoter holding; no new encumbrance/pledge created in FY26
fundamentals_narrative: High promoter holding (71.6%, no pledge) is a genuine positive signal of confidence, and the company operates in a niche where India's pollution-control/ESP regulations could theoretically provide a tailwind. But the numbers don't currently support that story: revenue is down ~17% YoY, ROCE/ROE are both weak (single digits), and the stock is down nearly half over the past year. Cheap on a simple P/E basis (~Rs 29.5 Cr market cap against Rs 4.16 Cr profit, ~7x) but cheap for a shrinking, low-return business is not the same as undervalued.
technical_read: Not pulled - four_box score is well below the promising threshold.

bse_notes: No red flag found: promoters confirmed no new share encumbrance/pledge in FY26 via routine SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure; promoter holding is high (71.6%).
